title: Hoax bomb threats spread from European flights to Irish newsrooms
caption:
A wave of hoax bomb threats that hit at least 27 flights across Europe on Thursday reached newsrooms on Friday, when RTÉ and other Irish media evacuated their Dublin offices. New threats also hit flights, and a plane was diverted to Venice. No bombs were found. Ireland's government says a coordinated campaign is likely, days before it hosts European leaders.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
